h1: AI use policy and safe sharing rules for your staff
overview: Without rules, someone will paste a customer list or a contract into a public chat tool. We write a short policy your team will actually read. It covers which tools are approved, what data may and may not be shared, who checks output before it goes to customers and what to do if something goes wrong. We include examples, a one page summary and a sign-off sheet.

faq: No. It is a practical workplace policy in plain English. If you handle regulated data such as health or financial records, ask a lawyer to review it before you adopt it.
Which tools does the policy cover?
Common chat tools, built-in features in your software, and any tool staff might try. We name the ones you approve and set the rule for anything new.
Short rules with real examples work better than long rules. We write for non experts and add a quiz and summary in the higher packages to help it stick.
Do you check what my staff really do?
No. We write the rules and do not monitor anyone. If you want to review current habits, ask about the tool review or audit services.
